subject: Procurement portal enrollment — MSA redline and PO field mapping
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@procureplus.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement portal enrollment — initial doc list and PO field questions

Amelia,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning — good to meet you. To keep the Ariba registration moving, can you confirm if ProcurePlus requires: 1) an executed MSA prior to portal activation, or 2) a signed order form alone for initial test orders?

From our side, legal is asking for the following evidence to complete the portal profile:
- Executed MSA (we can provide redlines if helpful)
- Certificate of insurance (commercial general liability + cyber)
- W9 and bank wiring instructions (or company ACH form)
- SOC 2 Type II report or completed security questionnaire (we can supply scoped evidence)

Separately, your ops contact mentioned the PO number prefix rule — they want a three-character vendor prefix inserted in the PO number (e.g., PPX-12345). Can you send the exact format and a short sample file? This will determine whether we need to populate an additional vendor code field in our order form.

I've attached a short onboarding checklist and the current MSA redline (v2) from Legal so you can see the open items. Karthik, looping you in for any technical guidance on the PO mapping.

Next steps proposed:
- ProcurePlus confirms whether an executed MSA is gating portal activation
- ProcurePlus shares PO field spec (sample file)
- Redwood confirms the minimum evidence package and whether SOC 2 scoping is acceptable

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Vendor Onboarding, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf, Redwood_MSA_redline_v2.docx
From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@procureplus.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Collins <ben.collins@procureplus.com>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 12:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Procurement portal enrollment — initial doc list and PO field questions

Hi Olga,

Thanks — great summary. Quick answers: we typically require an executed MSA for strategic vendors, but for platform/utility partners we can activate a limited portal account with an agreed order form and follow-up MSA signature within 30 days. For ProcurePlus, Ops is comfortable starting with a signed order form + PO test, provided Legal signs off on the redlines.

I'll upload the PO field spec in a moment (CSV sample) — Ben is copying to confirm the vendor-prefix requirement. For clarity: the prefix must be exactly three uppercase letters, followed by a hyphen and the numeric PO (e.g., PPX-000123). We do have a vendor code field in Ariba but some buyers still expect the prefix in the PO number itself.

Regarding evidence: SOC 2 Type II is preferred but if you can provide a security questionnaire plus SOC 2 in progress we can accept conditional activation (risk review pending). We also need the insurance cert and W9 before full activation.

On the MSA redline, can your Legal team mark the redlines using Word track changes and highlight any indemnity/limitation edits? If you can push v3 with tracked changes that will speed review.

Appreciate the checklist — Ben will upload the sample PO file by EOD.

Best,
Amelia Torres
Vendor Programs Manager, ProcurePlus
ProcurePlus Procurement <procurement@procureplus.com>

Attachments: (will upload ProcurePlus_PO_field_spec.xlsx)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement portal enrollment — initial doc list and PO field questions

Olga / Karthik —

I reviewed the MSA v2 you shared and sketched a focused v3 addressing the key gating items Amelia flagged. High-level guidance below:

1) Indemnity / limitation of liability: We should push to keep the mutual limitation language (cap tied to aggregate fees for the prior 12 months) but concede narrow carve-outs the buyer insists on. Draft language attached in "Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.docx" with tracked changes; please confirm whether ProcurePlus needs a $X carve-out for IP indemnity.

2) Activation gating: Legal is comfortable with Ops-led conditional activation if the Order Form is signed and (a) insurance cert and (b) W9 are received. SOC 2 in progress is acceptable with a remediation covenant in the order form.

3) PO field / prefix: If the prefix must appear in the PO number itself, Ops needs to know whether Ariba will accept incoming POs where vendor code is embedded in the number; Karthik can advise on mapping. If embedding causes rejection, we'll set vendor code in the vendor field and communicate the prefix expectation to buyers.

Olga: I'll attach v3 (tracked). Karthik: can you confirm whether our current Ariba connector supports the PPX- prefix and whether the connector will strip/accept it into our internal PO_number field? If not, propose an interim transform script.

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@procureplus.com>, Ben Collins <ben.collins@procureplus.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement portal enrollment — next steps and handoff

Amelia / Ben —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for confirming the conditional activation path. Summary of agreed next steps so we have a single action list:

1) Redwood: attach v3 MSA (tracked changes) and a short order-form addendum clause referencing SOC 2 remediation covenant (Markus).
2) ProcurePlus: upload ProcurePlus_PO_field_spec.xlsx (Ben) and confirm whether the Ariba mapping can accept PPX- prefix.
3) Redwood Ops (Karthik): validate connector behavior and, if needed, prepare a small transform to accept the PPX- prefix into internal PO_number (target ETA: 3 business days).
4) Both: ProcurePlus to accept conditional activation upon receipt of signed order form + insurance cert + W9. SOC 2 follow-up evidence within 30 days.

I'll attach the onboarding checklist and the v3 redline for your legal team to review. If ProcurePlus Legal can mark any further exceptions, please send them as redline comments so we can resolve quickly.

If everything is aligned we'll schedule a 30-minute handoff call Friday to confirm the mapping and final sign-off. Proposed times: 9:00am or 11:30am PT.

Olga Petrov
Head of Vendor Onboarding, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.docx, vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf
